identity.title: [v0.92][Runtime] Compose the production birthday and witness activation path

values.summary: Verify dependency ancestry and the source baseline, implement one Runtime-owned exactly-once birthday composition with a narrow live-resident adapter, run the renewed feature audit and focused production proof, update truth documents, then complete exact-head review and publication.

steps.action: Verify dependency terminal/merge ancestry, inspect merged authorities, and retain their exact production ownership boundaries.
Implement authenticated cross-binding and the crash-safe exactly-once birthday aggregate and recovery state machine.
Wire the narrow long-lived resident adapter and post-restore useful continuation without duplicating domain authorities.
Run focused positive, negative, restart, failpoint, concurrency, retained-evidence, and ordinary-resident proof.
Complete the renewed nine-feature production wiring audit, update canonical truth, obtain exact-head review, and publish with Closes #451.

invariants: Exactly one committed birthday per identity lineage
No mutation before all current authorities validate
No parallel writable identity continuity memory capability profile adaptive ACC or witness truth
Restart never replays activation or accepts rollback/copy/conflict
Audit and public evidence contain no private memory profile provider prompt or tool payload
risks: Merged authorities currently terminate at different crate boundaries
A broad adapter could accidentally create duplicate authority
Crash-safe exactly-once semantics require careful filesystem ordering
The renewed audit may reveal another feature that is still not production-wired
stop_conditions: Any dependency merge is not ancestral or its exact authority cannot be verified
Production identity continuity or witness authority would need to be fabricated
A required feature remains library-only fixture-only metadata-only documentation-only or unreachable
Exactly-once recovery cannot be proven under concurrency and interruption
The implementation requires Runtime v4 provider redesign AWS or unrelated scope
